source.title: T Natarajan returns to SRH, Zeeshan Ansari joins Delhi Capitals (IPL 2027 trade): 'before the IPL retention deadline expires on November 15'
source.note: No official BCCI / IPL notice found; September reports said the date wasn't announced yet.

source.title: IPL 2027 retention deadline (The Cricket News, citing Cricbuzz)
source.note: Also describes the trade window: closes a week before the auction, reopens a week after it until a month before the season; cash or player-swap trades, with the player's consent.

source.title: IPL 2027: Goa likely to host auction on December 16 as BCCI informs franchises
source.note: 'Likely': passed on informally, no formal notice yet. Venue Goa confirmed by the BCCI secretary (SportsDigest, 2026-09-23).

source.title: When is IPL auction? Date, venue, rules for the Indian Premier League 2027 mini-auction (Sporting News, via Yahoo Sports): 'reported to be on Wednesday, December 16, 2026', franchise briefing December 15, ITC Grand Goa; lists due to the BCCI by November 15
source.note: Still 'reported' (an earlier plan said December 14). Business Standard (2026-10-19) calls 16 December at ITC Grand Goa tentative. Checked 2026-10-22 (issue I5): no BCCI / IPL notice of the date yet, so the date stays an assumption.

source.title: IPL 2027 auction purse: searched 2026-10-22, nothing published (Sporting News via Yahoo Sports, 2026-10-18: 'total salary cap for 2027 is 157 crore'; 2026 'each team had a 125 crore limit')
source.note: Searched the press (ESPN, Business Standard, Business Today, Sporting News, Cricbuzz-sourced reports) and iplt20.com news on 2026-10-22: no 2027 auction purse announced. 125 cr kept as an assumption; replace when the retention lists (15 Nov) come with the remaining-purse table.

source.title: IPL 2027 auction set to take place in Goa in December (BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia)
IPL Governing Council announces TATA IPL player regulations 2025-27
source.note: Purse 120 cr for 2025; total salary cap (purse + performance pay + match fees) 146 / 151 / 157 cr for 2025 / 2026 / 2027. No 2027 auction purse is stated.

source.title: IPL 2026: how the squads stack up (each team's purse 'out of INR 125 crore')
source.note: The 2026 purse, used here for 2027 until a figure is published (assumption).

source.title: TATA IPL 2026 player retentions announced (25-player squads, 8 overseas)
TATA IPL 2026 player retentions announced (25-player squads, 8 overseas)
When will IPL 2027 players auction take place (teams may retain any number within squad rules)
source.note: Same rule as the 2026 mini year: 'The ten franchises were allowed to retain any number of players from their squad' (Wikipedia, citing The Times of India, 2025-11-12).

source.title: IPL 2026 retention rules explained (Times of India, via Wikipedia's 2026 personnel page)
source.note: No separate overseas retention limit in a mini year; the squad's overseas cap (8) applies.

source.title: IPL 2026 auction: key rules and changes explained ('no Right to Match card in the mini-auction')

IPL 2025 auction, retention rules: six retentions per team (slabs 18, 14, 11 cr for the first three capped players, 18 and 14 for the 4th and 5th, 4 cr for an uncapped player; 5 capped + 1 uncapped = 79 cr off the 120 cr purse)
source.note: The slabs are not in the official iplt20 release (it gives only the six-retention / RTM rule); ESPNcricinfo quotes the regulations document. Assumed to carry into 2027 (owner's decision, 2026-10-22) until the BCCI publishes 2027 rules.

source.title: IPL 2025 retentions: why KKR were deducted INR 69 crore despite spending INR 57 crore (the purse is debited the higher of the slab total and the actual retention spend)
source.note: No official wording of the 'higher of' rule was found; explainers only (also DNA India, 2024-11-03). Checked on the data: max(slab total, salary total) reproduces every team's published 2025 purse (Rajasthan Royals, 2024-11-21: RR 41, SRH 45, MI 45, KKR 51, CSK 55, GT 69, LSG 69, DC 73, RCB 83, PBKS 110.5 cr; RCB's 37 cr of salaries against 36 of slabs, KKR's 57 against 69) and, charging the 2025 retentions still on each squad, every team's published 2026 purse (`tests/test_competitions.py`).

source.title: Indian Premier League 2025 mega auction: IPL teams' remaining purse (Rajasthan Royals)
source.note: The 2025 remaining purses the slab rule is checked against.

source.title: TATA IPL 2026 player retentions announced (remaining purse = purse - retained salaries, with the 2025 retentions at their slab)
source.note: In a mini year a kept player stays on his contract; the remaining-purse table is the purse less those salaries, except that a player retained at the 2025 mega auction is still charged by the retention slabs. With that charge (and Vipraj Nigam's 2025 price corrected to 0.5 cr) our squads file reproduces the published 2026 table exactly for all 10 teams.

source.title: IPL 2025: two-year ban for overseas players pulling out after being picked at auction ('Any overseas player's auction fee at small auction will be lower of the highest retention price and the highest auction price at the mega auction'; the excess goes to the BCCI for players' welfare; the full price is charged to the team's purse)
source.note: ESPNcricinfo quoting the regulations document; not in the iplt20 release. The cap limits the player's FEE, not the bid: bidding goes on, and the franchise's purse is debited the full bid. Cap = min(18 cr top retention slab, 27 cr top 2025 mega price) = 18 cr.

source.title: Why Cameron Green won Rs 25.20 crore but took home Rs 18 crore (KKR's purse debited the full 25.20 cr; 7.2 cr to BCCI player welfare)
source.note: Also IANS (2025-12-16). The squads file keeps the bid as `salary_cr` (what the franchise's purse paid); the price model prices the bid. Whether the cap applies again in 2027 isn't reported; the regulation covers 2025-27, so it is kept.

source.title: Wikipedia, 2026 personnel changes: retention 'including traded players while excluding players signed as temporary replacements'
source.note: Only *temporary* replacements were excluded in 2026; we assume a season-long 2026 replacement may be kept at his replacement fee.

source.title: IPL auction 2023 FAQs (75% minimum spend rule, documented 2018-2023)
source.note: Not mentioned in the 2025-27 regulations; left at 0 (no rule) as an assumption.

source.title: Wikipedia, List of 2027 Indian Premier League personnel changes (trades since the 2026 season, retirements)
source.note: Pant (LSG -> DC, 15 cr) for Kuldeep Yadav (DC -> LSG, 13.5 cr); T Natarajan (DC -> SRH, 5 cr) for Zeeshan Ansari (SRH -> DC, 0.4 cr); Ajinkya Rahane (KKR) retired. Applied to the squads file.

source.title: IPL player regulations 2025-27: two-season ban for a bought player who pulls out; overseas players must register for the mega auction to enter the next mini auctions; uncapped = no international XI / central contract in the previous 5 calendar years
